attributes.visState: {"title": "Inference tokens by model", "type": "vega", "aggs": [], "params": {"spec": "{\"$schema\": \"https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json\", \"description\": \"Kibana inference token usage by model.\", \"autosize\": {\"type\": \"fit\", \"contains\": \"padding\"}, \"data\": {\"url\": {\"%type%\": \"esql\", \"%context%\": true, \"%timefield%\": \"@timestamp\", \"query\": \"FROM .kibana-inference-token-usage\\n| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend\\n| STATS tokens = SUM(token_usage.total_tokens) BY model = model.model_id\\n| SORT tokens DESC\\n| LIMIT 12\"}}, \"encoding\": {\"y\": {\"field\": \"model\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Model\", \"sort\": \"-x\", \"axis\": {\"labelLimit\": 220, \"labelPadding\": 4, \"grid\": false}}, \"x\": {\"field\": \"tokens\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Tokens\", \"axis\": {\"grid\": true, \"tickCount\": 5}}}, \"layer\": [{\"mark\": {\"type\": \"bar\", \"cornerRadiusEnd\": 3, \"tooltip\": true, \"height\": {\"band\": 0.72}}, \"encoding\": {\"color\": {\"field\": \"tokens\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"scale\": {\"scheme\": \"tealblues\"}, \"legend\": null}, \"tooltip\": [{\"field\": \"model\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Model\"}, {\"field\": \"tokens\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Tokens\", \"format\": \",.0f\"}]}}, {\"mark\": {\"type\": \"text\", \"align\": \"left\", \"baseline\": \"middle\", \"dx\": 4, \"fontSize\": 11, \"color\": \"#343741\"}, \"encoding\": {\"text\": {\"field\": \"tokens\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"format\": \",.0f\"}}}], \"config\": {\"view\": {\"stroke\": null}, \"axis\": {\"labelFontSize\": 11, \"titleFontSize\": 12, \"domain\": false}}}"}}
